content.text:
Moved the objectsigner gating out of the plugin factory and into registration setup.

`RegisterObjectSigner()` in [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go](/home/coder/git/entireio/cli-sign/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go) now resolves the config, applies the skip conditions up front, constructs the signer once, and only registers the plugin if signing should actually proceed. That means cases like missing config loader, `commit.gpgsign=false`, custom `gpg.ssh.program`, or signer construction failure now short-circuit before registration instead of returning `nil` from the factory.

I also updated [cmd/entire/cli/root_test.go](/home/coder/git/entireio/cli-sign/cmd/entire/cli/root_test.go) to cover both registration and skip behavior without relying on mutable global go-git plugin config state.
